shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: Top edge of the bottom sheet.

components.name: Chip
components.description: Question and filter chip; selected state is solid teal.

narrative.overview: A knowledgeable clerk who slides the one page you need across warm paper and says it in plain words. Calm type, rationed color, every claim next to its source.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, white panel, navy text.
Teal marks everything operable or selected.
Orange only where the draft changes something.
Status shown by glyph and outline style, never color alone.

rules.name: The Orange Means Change Rule
rules.body: Orange never decorates. If a thing is orange, the draft changes it.

rules.name: The Never Color Alone Rule
rules.body: Answer states differ by glyph and line style as well as hue.

rules.name: The Float Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows mean this sits above the map.

dos: Do keep orange for changes only.
Do pair every status color with a glyph and line style.
donts: Don't open in dark mode by default.
Don't introduce a fifth answer state.
